name: Sundrift product traffic
description: Seeded 180-day sessions, conversion, and AOV for Sundrift travel products. Constant values for the conference demo. Not a live analytics ingest.

panels.title: Sessions by product
panels.sql: SELECT product, sessions FROM (VALUES ('The Weekender'::text, 9421), ('Packing cubes', 14880), ('Linen travel shirts', 4102), ('Care+ lounge', 1860), ('The Drift Carry-On', 6204), ('The Coast Tote', 5330)) AS metrics(product, sessions) ORDER BY sessions DESC

panels.title: Revenue by product
panels.sql: SELECT product, round(sessions * conversion_pct / 100.0 * aov, 2) AS revenue FROM (VALUES ('The Weekender'::text, 9421::float8, 4.52::float8, 52.37::float8), ('Packing cubes', 14880, 3.10, 28.00), ('Linen travel shirts', 4102, 3.80, 68.00), ('Care+ lounge', 1860, 6.90, 24.00), ('The Drift Carry-On', 6204, 2.40, 198.00), ('The Coast Tote', 5330, 3.40, 86.00)) AS metrics(product, sessions, conversion_pct, aov) ORDER BY revenue DESC
